thesis: The strongest short thesis is not business fragility but valuation and regulation. Visa trades above locked Base value and at the upper half of its five-year P/E history. Routing mandates, interchange pressure, account-to-account rails and rising client incentives could compress economics. Even so, current evidence does not establish any exact Hard Veto.

evidence.claim: Current price/Base is about 1.121 and 5Y P/E percentile about 69%.
Q3 processed transactions and payments volume both grew 10%.

counterevidence: VAS is growing materially faster than core payments.
Visa repurchases substantial stock and has modest net debt relative to cash flow.
falsifiers: Sustained VAS growth, stable take rates and resilient volume weaken the short thesis; adverse regulation with falling net revenue per transaction strengthens it.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: No restatement, auditor dispute or control failure is established.
Strong OCF and manageable net debt rebut structural dependence on outside capital.
Visa is a large net repurchaser.
Mission-critical network usage and transaction growth demonstrate real customer value.
Asset-light cash economics and VAS growth do not establish structural incremental-ROIC collapse.
Current payment, transaction and VAS growth do not establish continuing moat shrinkage.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: The price is above Base but below Bull; Bull+ is not required.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Visa has diversified geographies, clients, payment flows and VAS; no single dependency is fatal.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Strong OCF and manageable leverage make bankruptcy/forced financing remote.

next_checks: FY2026 10-K, regulation, VAS growth, buyback pricing
